title: VanillaEmpire+ Playerpacks
description: A modpack collection for all Seasons + Versions for VanillaEmpire+
body:
### Welcome to the VanillaEmpire+ official player modpack! 

_**Carefully curated Client-sided Modpack for optimal performance and player experience.
The peformance comes from Sodium, Iris, and Lithium for stunning graphics without sacrificing framerate. 
Navigate with Xaero's maps, communicate via Simple Voice Chat, and enjoy seamless QOL features: inventory sorter, dynamic lighting, armor/food HUDs, and MiniHUD stats. Bobby keeps your view distance high but optimized.**_

**_This also allows you to join your friends on Vanilla servers, whilst maintaining a buttery-smooth and a visually stunning experience_**
